name: soc-radar
label: SOCRadar
description: Threat Intelligence enriched with External Attack Surface Management and Digital Risk Protection Services

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: url
fields.description: Specify the URL of the SOCRadar server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Company ID
fields.name: company_id
fields.description: Specify the Company ID used to access the SOCRadar server.

fields.title: Company API Key
fields.name: company_key
fields.description: Specify the Company API Key used to access the SOCRadar server.
fields.tooltip: Create a key at company settings

fields.title: Threat Analysis API Key
fields.name: threat_analysis_api_key
fields.description: Specify the Threat Analysis API Key. Required for Threat Analysis and Malware Analysis operations.
fields.tooltip: Please obtain your SOCRadar malware analysis API key by contacting operation@socradar.io

fields.title: Multi-Tenant ID
fields.name: multi_tenant_id
fields.description: Specify the Multi-Tenant ID for provisioning multi-tenant management operations.
fields.tooltip: Required only for multi-tenant management operations

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Get Incidents
operations.description: Retrieves a list of incidents based on the start date, end date, and pagination parameters.

parameters.title: Start Date
parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of the time range (Datetime or Unix Timestamp).

parameters.title: End Date
parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of the time range (Datetime or Unix Timestamp).

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records per page (max 100).

parameters.title: Page
parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of records to retrieve.

operations.title: Get Incident
operations.description: Retrieves details of a single incident based on the Alarm ID.

parameters.title: Alarm ID
parameters.name: alarm_id
parameters.description: Alarm ID to fetch details for.

operations.title: Threat Analysis
operations.description: Retrieves the trust score (out of 100) for an entity (IPv4, IPv6, Domain, or Hash).

parameters.title: Entity
parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to analyze. Valid types: IPv4, IPv6, Domain, Hash.

parameters.title: Force New Analysis
parameters.name: force_new_analysis
parameters.description: Bypass 24-hour cache and force a new analysis.

operations.title: Change Status
operations.description: Updates the status of an incident based on the Alarm ID.

parameters.name: alarm_id
parameters.description: ID of the alarm to update.
